adjustments.change: Keep the priority on not-yet-inspected closed containers (including the fridge) over re-checking locations already observed empty, but widen the object of that preference from 'closed container or goal-relevant appliance' to any not-yet-inspected location, explicitly including surfaces not yet observed; condition the fridge clause on the fridge not yet having been opened; retain the take-immediately and transform-before-delivery requirement.
adjustments.reason: The current `G2` failures (`P6`, `P7`, `P10`) hit the step limit (`P6:50`, `P7:50`, `P10:50`) while repeatedly re-entering locations already seen to contain nothing (`P6:24`, `P6:28`, `P6:32`, `P6:38`; `P7:23`, `P7:28`; `P10:29`, `P10:35`) and never opening the fridge, although the fridge is present and was observed to hold target-type items (`P2:12`, plate 2 and mug 2); `P5` only succeeded after its cabinet sweep reached cabinet 9 (`P5:30`, `P5:31`). This supports retaining priority on unopened closed containers, including the fridge. However `M3` reports that a container-class-priority sweep made a candidate stay inside one container class and never try surfaces that held the target (`M3`, evidence `S1_R02/P7:1`, `S1_R02/P7:2`, `S1_R02/Q7:1`, `S1_R02/Q7:39`), so the object of the preference is widened to any not-yet-inspected location (surfaces included) and the fridge clause is made conditional on its not having been opened. `M3` also reports no detour where a direct route was already followed (`S1_R01/P9:2`, `S1_R01/P9:4`). The completed-run behaviors (immediate pickup, transform before delivery) are preserved. Whether the widened preference measurably improves coverage within the budget is an unverified hypothesis.

adjustments.change: Narrow the cycle-breaking trigger to what the actor's recent observations can support (do not return to a location just shown to contain no new object), and change the break action to select a destination that expands coverage - an unopened closed container (especially the fridge) or a not-yet-observed surface - rather than a 'container or appliance not recently checked'; retain the carve-out for a single necessary revisit.
adjustments.reason: Current runs show repeated non-adjacent travel with no new object (`P6:24`-`P6:49`; `P7:23`, `P7:28`; `P10:29`, `P10:35`), matching the original concern. But `M3` reports that a literal last-two anti-revisit restriction did not remove cycles of three or more sites, and that the actor sees only the current observation, the admissible actions and the last two observation/action pairs with no persistent notes (`M3`, evidence `S1_R02/Q4:21`, `S1_R02/Q4:50`, `S1_R02/Q8:44`, `S1_R02/Q8:50`), and that joint anti-revisit/search guidance did not uniformly reduce sweeps (`M3`, evidence `S1_R01/Q6:14`, `S1_R01/Q6:23`, `S1_R01/Q8:7`, `S1_R01/Q8:9`). The trigger is therefore narrowed to returns detectable from recent observations, and the break destination is re-pointed to a location that expands coverage (an unopened closed container, notably the fridge, or a not-yet-observed surface), consistent with the widened preference in `u1`. The necessary-revisit carve-out is preserved. Whether this weaker, feasible trigger actually reduces cycling is an unverified hypothesis.
